_how_to_edit: Add a swap under 'swaps': the key is the ingredient in lowercase, matched as whole words (longest match wins). Add phrases that must NEVER get a swap to 'never_swap'. Categories: sweetener, artificial sweetener, fat & oil, grain & flour, salt, dairy, preservative, color, additive.

sugar.reason: Less refined and sweeter, so you can use less.

high fructose corn syrup.replacement: pure maple syrup or fruit puree
high fructose corn syrup.reason: Avoids a highly processed sweetener linked to excess calorie intake.

brown sugar.reason: Sweetness that comes with fiber and potassium.

brown rice syrup.replacement: date paste or a little maple syrup
brown rice syrup.reason: Brown rice syrup is almost pure glucose and spikes blood sugar.

glucose syrup.reason: Adds sweetness with fiber instead of a refined syrup.

evaporated cane juice.replacement: fruit puree or less added sugar
evaporated cane juice.reason: It is still sugar under another name.

maltodextrin.replacement: whole grains or a fiber thickener like inulin
maltodextrin.reason: Highly processed starch that raises blood sugar quickly.

enriched flour.reason: Whole grains keep the fiber that refining removes.

enriched wheat flour.reason: Whole grains keep the fiber that refining removes.

bleached flour.reason: Whole grains keep the fiber that refining removes.

wheat flour.reason: Whole grains keep the fiber that refining removes.

white rice flour.reason: Keeps the bran, so more fiber and minerals.

potassium bromate.reason: Potassium bromate is a flour additive banned in many countries.

palm oil.reason: Less saturated fat and more heart-healthy fats.

palm kernel oil.reason: Palm kernel oil is mostly saturated fat.

hydrogenated.reason: Hydrogenated oils can contain trans fats.

partially hydrogenated.reason: Partially hydrogenated oils are the main source of artificial trans fats.

soybean oil.reason: More monounsaturated fat and less omega-6.

cottonseed oil.reason: Highly refined oil; olive oil has more heart-healthy fats.

salt.replacement: herbs and spices or low-sodium salt

cream cheese.replacement: Neufchatel or Greek yogurt cream cheese

cheddar cheese.reason: Less saturated fat with the same flavor.

mozzarella cheese.reason: Less saturated fat and fewer calories.

sodium benzoate.replacement: products preserved with vitamin C or vitamin E

sodium nitrite.reason: Processed meats with nitrites are linked to health risks.

sodium nitrate.reason: Processed meats with nitrates are linked to health risks.

bht.replacement: products preserved with vitamin E (mixed tocopherols)
bht.reason: Natural antioxidant instead of a synthetic one.

bha.replacement: products preserved with vitamin E (mixed tocopherols)
bha.reason: Natural antioxidant instead of a synthetic one.

tbhq.replacement: products preserved with vitamin E (mixed tocopherols)
tbhq.reason: Natural antioxidant instead of a synthetic one.

caramel color.reason: Some caramel colors contain unwanted by-products; color adds nothing nutritionally.

red 40.reason: Plant-based color instead of a synthetic dye.

yellow 5.reason: Plant-based color instead of a synthetic dye.

yellow 6.reason: Plant-based color instead of a synthetic dye.

blue 1.reason: Plant-based color instead of a synthetic dye.

titanium dioxide.reason: Titanium dioxide is no longer allowed as a food additive in the EU.

artificial flavors.replacement: natural spices, vanilla or citrus zest

artificial flavor.replacement: natural spices, vanilla or citrus zest

phosphoric acid.replacement: sparkling water with lemon or lime
phosphoric acid.reason: High intake from sodas is linked to lower bone density.

carrageenan.replacement: products thickened with guar gum, or none
carrageenan.reason: Some people find carrageenan irritates the gut.
